C0430.title: China's Ministry of Public Security Deploys Crackdown on Cyber-Enabled Mafia-Like Crimes Including Negative Public Opinion Extortion
C0430.summary: In February 2023, the Ministry of Public Security held a video conference to advance the crackdown on cyber-enabled mafia-like crimes, focusing on offenses such as sextortion, online predatory lending, soft-violence debt collection, malicious claims, negative public opinion extortion, and paid internet trolls, aiming to curb the rising trend of such cases.

references.title: Nude Chat Extortion, Soft Violence Debt Collection... Ministry of Public Security Strikes Hard!
